messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about Media in German Democratic Republic (1949-1990) during the 1980s, matching this research need: Survey data on audience participation and television viewing behavior, including recent program exposure and evaluations, perceived informational and entertainment value, interest in economic-social policy programming and rock/pop music, announcer ratings, and respondent demographics.
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.

Woche 1983 (SFR 6/83)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.7055","justification":"Highly relevant survey dataset collected on February 9, 1983, by the GDR State Committee for Television, Department of Sociological Research. Measures television audience participation, viewing behavior, and evaluations of programs watched during the preceding week. Includes assessments of entertainment value, informational content, presenters, target age groups, and audience preferences. Particularly useful for studying perceptions of informational and entertainment programming and evaluations of television personalities. Part of GESIS's historical GDR television audience research collection."},{"title":"Sofortresonanzen DDR Fernsehen 50. Woche 1982 (SFR 50/82)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.7047","justification":"Survey conducted on December 16, 1982, examining audience participation and evaluations of recently broadcast television programs. Includes perceived entertainment value, humor, program quality, desired improvements, and informational value of particular broadcasts. Especially relevant for analyzing audience responses to entertainment and informational programming. Provides historical survey evidence of television consumption patterns in the GDR during the early 1980s."},{"title":"Sofortresonanzen DDR Fernsehen 46. Woche 1984 (SFR 46/84)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.7147","justification":"Highly relevant dataset collected on November 16, 1984, addressing television viewing behavior and evaluations of programs broadcast during the previous week. Additional questions examine reception and evaluation of the informational program 'Umschau,' interest in program topics, knowledge of television schedules, preferences for youth programming, and the influence of shift work and parents on viewing behavior. Includes demographic variables such as household size, age, gender, education, occupation, continuing education, and political party membership. Particularly valuable for examining informational programming, audience interests, viewing patterns, and demographic differences."},{"title":"Sofortresonanzen DDR Fernsehen 36. Woche 1985 (SFR 36/85)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.7189","justification":"GDR television audience survey conducted on August 31, 1985. Records exposure to and evaluations of television programs broadcast during the preceding week. Includes assessments of presenters, entertainment value, perceived realism of televised drama, audience expectations, and television program preferences. Useful for investigating presenter ratings, program reception, audience satisfaction, and entertainment preferences during the mid-1980s."},{"title":"Sofortresonanzen DDR Fernsehen 23. Woche 1987 (SFR 23/87)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA7281","justification":"Survey from 1987 examining television audience participation and evaluations of recently broadcast programs. Includes informational value, perceived realism, presenter assessments, audience opinions, and interest in problems discussed in particular broadcasts. Relevant for studying how East German viewers evaluated informational content, program credibility, presenters, and socially relevant subjects. Provides evidence of television reception and audience interests in the late 1980s."},{"title":"Sofortresonanzen DDR Fernsehen 35. Woche 1988 (SFR 35/88)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.10584","justification":"Audience research dataset from 1988 measuring television viewing and evaluations of programs broadcast during the previous week. Includes assessments of entertainment value, realism, presenters, humor, program components, and the practical usefulness of informational television content. Also examines viewing frequency and audience preferences for youth programming. Relevant for analyzing entertainment and informational value, presenter ratings, and audience segmentation."},{"title":"Sofortresonanzen DDR Fernsehen 28. Woche 1989 (SFR 28/89)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA7389","justification":"GDR television audience survey conducted in 1989. Covers participation in and evaluations of recently broadcast programs, including assessments of performers, presenters, musical variety, and overall satisfaction with East German television. Also examines audience responses to specific cultural and political programming. Particularly relevant for research on music-related entertainment, presenter evaluations, audience satisfaction, and changing television preferences toward the end of the 1980s."},{"title":"Sofortresonanzen DDR Fernsehen 39. Woche 1982 (SFR 39/82)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA7464","justification":"Representative household survey from 1982 investigating television viewing behavior and evaluations of programs broadcast during the preceding week. Includes detailed assessments of entertainment programming, an international popular-music festival broadcast, presenters, program design, and audience responses to portrayals of young people's experiences. Particularly relevant for examining popular-music programming, entertainment preferences, presenter ratings, and youth-oriented television content in the GDR."},{"title":"Sofortresonanzen DDR Fernsehen 14. Woche 1982 (SFR 14/82)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA7012","justification":"Survey dataset from 1982 covering audience participation and evaluations of television programs watched during the preceding week. Includes perceived entertainment value, realism, awareness of specific programs, and audience responses to television drama and youth-oriented programming. Useful for investigating television exposure, program awareness, perceived entertainment value, and reception of different television genres in the early 1980s."},{"title":"Sofortresonanzen DDR Fernsehen 13. Woche 1985 (SFR 13/85)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.7166","justification":"Survey from 1985 addressing television viewing behavior, recent program exposure, and audience evaluations. Includes entertainment value, realism, audience expectations, interest in cultural programming, preferred program topics, and viewing frequency. Also investigates occupational characteristics, physical and mental workload, and fatigue after work, allowing connections between respondents' social circumstances and television preferences. Particularly relevant for examining entertainment needs, program interests, and socioeconomic influences on television consumption."}]}
